scope: full per segment, no cross-segment pose pairing
statistic: Arithmetic mean of sequence-level paired RMSE differences
sequence_rmse: sqrt(sum(per-segment RMSE^2 * eligible motion pairs) / sum(eligible motion pairs))
model_ci: marginal per-model mean intervals; pair-comparison CI resamples matching sequences together
p90_p95: across sequence-level RMSEs; not a motion-pair distribution

compression_screen.relative_gt_step_floor: 0.5× median nonzero GT displacement in the same segment and offset
compression_screen.interpretation: descriptive recurrence screen, overlapping starts not independent
